errors.evidence: The vertical axis (Percentage) range is from 0.0 to 0.8, not 0.0% to 76.2%. 76.2% is the value of the tallest bar, not the maximum value of the axis.
The tick intervals are 0.1 for the y-axis and 0.2 for the x-axis. Stating them as percentages (0.1% and 0.2%) is incorrect by a factor of 100.

errors.text_span: The single bar is colored light blue and extends approximately 0.8 units along the horizontal axis, corresponding to approximately 76.2% accuracy, with associated values of 11.2%, 3.4%, 3.4%, and 5.8% shown as text labels below the bar.
errors.evidence: The chart contains five bars, not a 'single bar'. This sentence incorrectly conflates the five distinct data points into one, and also incorrectly states that the labels are 'below the bar' when they are above.
The description fails to mention the prominent red dashed vertical line at Pass@1 = 0.82 and the associated red text annotation 'mean: 0.82'.
